posts.title: A Real-World Law-Enforcement Hack: The Case of Encrochat
posts.description: Our paper A Real-World Law-Enforcement Hack: The Case of Encrochat has been accepted to CRYPTO 2026 and the full version is available; “us” is Sunoo Park, Mike Specter, Douglas Stebila and me.
